notes.title: Falnarion Tactics Surprise Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33849709/4984cc5e3dee294bf2e71f11603838476a8ea319.png[/img]

Falnarion Tactics Surprise Update!


-Added in extra class change options for some characters.
(Dreth and Oresha can become Sharpshooters, Sheru can become a Marauder).

-Added in a new side quest; Stronghold Vier. It features several new enemies and allies.

-A brief interaction between Whisper and Aldren about religion is added in the base menu.

-Added in two more Rewind Crystals in the Item Shop for more replay value.

-Added in the Exiori as an purchasable weapon.

-Some story mission unit limits have increased.

-Updated some character bios and added in two new bios

It also may or may not be getting an update in the near future. Anyways, that's it for now!

notes.title: Falnarion Tactics Final Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33849709/4984cc5e3dee294bf2e71f11603838476a8ea319.png[/img]

It's been a very long time since this game got updated. That is because I thought the files were lost long ago. But, I managed to find them. This game is, in fact complete. But, I thought I'd give it one last kiss goodbye, like the rest of my SRPG games before I stop working on them for good.

Welcome to the final update of Falnarion Tactics.


-Here is what is new:


-Changed the font to something a lot more clearer.

-Severely buffed the sword; Dragon Slayer.

-Increased the durability of all weapons by 5.

-Added in a new side quest; Otherwordly.

-Added in two songs from the Euclyca OST; "At Odds" and "First Encounter"

-Added in the unit limit information for every side quest before departure.

-Added in a Utility Hammer (Allows you to repair your weapons).
You can find it in the item shop.

-Fixed the left over movement skill for all actions instead of just a few.

-Added in a Rewind Crystal. (Allows you to repeat some side quests).
You can find it in the item shop.

-Added in four new characters; Clairena and Haru (Aeloren Tactics).
Milo (Falnarion Tactics II) and Skaul (Tales of Beasteria).

-Added in Last Stand Mode which allows you to fight a variety of side quests
as a limited roaster (Mainly the cast of Inelda).
It is available at the start of a new game.

-Buffed Arestol and Momo's magic damage.

-Some classes have been buffed slightly. All mounted classes' movement has been
increased moderately.

-Luna and Charlotte now know the "Looting/Capture" skill.

-Fixed Erica not being able to be deployed in chapters 11 and 12.

-Chat boxes of characters who aren't speaking during chat will be blacked out,
to help understand who is currently speaking better. (Just like in Falnarion Tactics II).

-Removed various unused plugins and sadly removed the "Suspend" plugin as well.
This is in hopes that the random crashing that many people experience will now come
to an end and won't happen anymore.

-Fixed the inability to take screenshots through the Steam overlay.

*Oh and for the last damn time, this isn't RPG Maker. No RPG Maker has the capability of producing
a game like this. Also if it was RPG Maker, you could walk around freely in it.


Lastly, happy holidays to you and yours!

notes.title: All updates have concluded for Falnarion Tactics.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33849709/47ac0b30da7fc3562205ba77f4df2a24a4e3cc1f.png[/img]
If you browse the community hub for the news tab. You will find that this game has been updated quickly and efficiently without a moment's notice. It is my one and only game in early access and I took that very seriously. With that being said, the game is finished and has received some extra content for free. I'm on my way out of being a Dev, so I won't linger around updating it anymore. It's not an MMORPG or a complex Battle Royal. So it doesn't need frequent updates. Most Single Player games are one and done anyways. But, I don't believe in micro-transactions or crappy DLC, so I wouldn't lock future content behind a pay wall if it was needed to enjoy the game or beat it. All my games are beatable with the right strategy and mindset. This game has a bit of a history behind it though. It came out in November in early access, has been entered in a Indie Game contest *One and only time* and have been given silly negative and positive reviews it doesn't quite deserve. Seriously the attention this game got was more then a lot of my other games, but one review in particular I won't point out has become a bit of a meme I won't be forgetting any time soon. "Falnarion Tactics has a story? What Story?" lol. It's funny because anyone who has seen the trailers, store page or played the game. Knows for a fact it has a story. It is as a well known fact as Call of Duty having guns. If you want a game that doesn't have a story well. There is Solenars Edge Heroes, Fesnia and Estellium Legends. Other then that all my games have a story that have come to an end. Speaking of Estellium Legends, because of the type of game it is, it won't receive just 3 updates, it will receive close to the amount that Heroes did. There is a lot more content to add to that game in the future and it will improve over time, even though IMO it's good already. So to end this post. Thank for your interest in Falnarion Tactics and I hope you continue to enjoy it if you are still trying to beat the story, play more side quests or just starting for the first time. It's a Team Syukino game to remember.
The news on the game page will still be updated for the time being, but will mainly focus on Team Syukino and Estellium Legends. There will be a separate post in the future when the news updates are concluded.

notes.title: Regarding reviews on Steam.
notes.content: I'd like to call to attention reviews in general on Steam. Not just to my games, but to games across steam in general. I'm good with a positive or negative review. Hell, I'm even good with memes or jokes. I'm even good with a negative review that just says "It's bad." But, lets be honest. Most people go straight to the reviews of a game first before deciding to buy it or not. Most of the time, the negative reviews outshine the multiple good ones and they are taken notice and into consideration more even though they aren't actually there for a good reason. If I were to review a game like Call of Duty and say something like "It has no guns." You would think I was trolling, but if I told you I was serious. Then you would probably think I was stupid. The issue here is that, while people have many reasons to not like a game and have the right to criticize and share their opinion. They should be informative about it. Keep in mind that, some things that people say aren't related to most people or aren't actually true at all. Like for example the cup head tutorial journalist incident. That tutorial was probably one of the easiest things about a game that is actually hard. So to not like the game simply because you can't play the game right doesn't exactly make it bad. Like for example I suck so bad at Metal Gear Solid, but the games are great and beloved, a bit complicated, but great. So the point is here. If you are going to leave a negative or positive review on any game on steam, please have it a bit informative and not misinform people on what the actual game is like due to your inability to press a button, or to play the game correctly or to just be able to read for a couple of minutes. Falnarion Tactics has story. Now it can be a cheesy one, you can hate it. That is fine. Leave a negative review about how you do not like the story if you want. Great. At-least you are acknowledging that fact that something about the game is actually there and in your own informative opinion don't like it. That in fact lets people have some sort of hint on whether or not they want to buy it. But sadly, the awareness being brought here is that a ton of people spread misinformation in reviews mainly through negative and it really prevents you, the consumer, from enjoying things you could like. It's like don't judge a book by it's cover? But not quite. To end this: If I were to put something on the store page and it wasn't in the game, then Steam wouldn't allow the game to have a store page in the first place. So read the store pages just as you read this long comment. It will save your life and greatly influence your next game purchase. That is all and thanks~

notes.title: Some important stuff to know.
notes.content:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/974180/discussions/0/1742226629863232847/

Other then the list above, here are some important tips about the game.

1. Due to this program's limitations, you may get a crash when starting up the game while using two monitors. You can possibly fix this by using mirror mode instead of extend or just using one monitor entirely.

2. When it comes to side quests there are three types. Regular side quests separated by red flag icons. Character recruitment quests separated by the grey character icon. Lastly there are boss missions that may be tough, but yield nice rewards. These are separated by the monster icons.

3. When in the base camp you can choose "Info" in order to look at recent conversations with your members, hints and tips about the game or to unlock secret actions. Main characters' dialogue will come and go. Side quest character dialogue will stay throughout the game. Be sure to check the Info in the base quite often.

4. Not all villages, ruins or decorations on the map are able to be interacted with. Yes, you can interact with some, but the amount you can interact with throughout the game is very minor.

5. The take over shop is another bonus points shop. You can use bonus points to purchase things from both bonus points shop or use them to level up your units. You can get things in these shops you aren't normally able to purchase in the normal shops.

6. You can join the Team Syukino discord server for real time updates about any Team Syukino game including Falnarion Tactics.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33849709/47ac0b30da7fc3562205ba77f4df2a24a4e3cc1f.png[/img]

Welcome to another very fast Falnarion Tactics update.
The game has been updated roughly six times in v0.9 to fix some issues.
We are now already in v0.9.5. I would like to take a moment to wish everyone
a happy new year and let you know those of you who have had a somewhat
medicore year this year. That eventually it does get better. So keep
on fighting. I also want to bring to the attention that work on Ataemasu
is continuing. There is also a special message in the credits of this game
and will be available in v1.0 in the weeks to come. This is a brief update,
but let us see whats new anyways.

-Added in a new and final side quest; Lost Kingdom. You can obtain Charlotte the Merchant here.
*Charlotte is the Queen of Kessania's merchant and a traveling one that sells Scythes and guns and is now playable if you complete this quest. She is somewhat like Anna from Fire Emblem.*
*The original Lost Kingdom is now Lost Kingdom II and it's where you get Soren.
They are not the same, but take place on the same map location.*

-Added in a Magic Potion in the trade over shop that will give Habber the ability to transform
in a new game+ *May have to wait for the game to be finished until that is possible to use.*

*This is again the first and last game that will ever be in Early Access. I do not like EA
and thats why I wanted it to be as quick as possible in it. I've updated it several times
quickly and I hope that you enjoy the final product in 2019.* Thanks for your
support and please look forward to the release on January 15th 2019.

notes.title: Falnarion Tactics v0.9 update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33849709/47ac0b30da7fc3562205ba77f4df2a24a4e3cc1f.png[/img]
Hello everyone and welcome to yet another update of Falnarion Tactics.
We have come such a long way in such a short amount of time and the game is just about finished. If you haven't bought it yet, please consider!
Also I hope you guys have been enjoying your break and look forward to the new year!
So let us get underway on some new changes.

Take a look:

-Chapter 10 added.

-Added in more of a tutorial on top of
Arestol's explainations and the vistable village
explainations as well for chapter zero.

-Fixed some issues.

-Fixed an issue that a certain character didn't disappear after a certain
event.

-Arestol nerfed.

-Felm nerfed.

-Selten nerfed.

-Brethica nerfed.

-Dreth buffed.

-Flambraken appearence change.

-Dagger appearence change.

-Soldier Spear apprearence change.

-Tribal Spear appearence change.

-Steel Bow appearence change.

-Short Bow appearence change.

-Sturdy Lance appearence change.

-Iron Scythe appearence change.

-Rapier appearence change.

-Brave Sword appearence change.

-Bronze Sword is now Steel Sword.

-Changed Gelmara's battle animation.

-Matreus appearence change (in combat).

-Some staff icons have been changed.

-Some icon changes.

-Changed Samantha's map sprite.

-Changed Dreth's map sprite for when he is
a Sniper.

-Slight U.I. Changes.

-At level 20, Luna can learn Looting.
Looting captures the enemy and allows usage
of their items.

-Ashelo can now transform into an Angel.
She cannot fight during her transformation,
but her healing abilities and survivability are
boosted. This transformation is suggested
to make a quick getaway.

-Removed Arestol's ability to turn into a Sage.

-Added in a new bow; Artemis Bow.

-Added in a new gun; Sniper Rifle.

-Fixed Excalibur's Icon.

-Added in a new sword; Mage Killer (Mainly used by enemies in chapters 10 and 11).

-Added in a new sword; Oracle Blade (Wielded by Algorium).

-Added in a new sword; Masamune.

*v1.0 will contain the final chapters 11 and 12 and there won't be a break inbetween them.
*There may be a v0.9.5 before-hand depending on things,

That is all for now. Once we get to v1.0, the game is released. Take care and have a happy new year!

Release date: January 15th. *Subject to change*

*Also to note: Falnarion Tactics' demo build. Which was roughly v0.2 ranked 80 out of 333 entries in the Indie Game Making Contest on Itch.io. The game has changed a lot since then and continues to improve!

*One last thing. If I could review my own games I would give this one 7.5/10 too much Whamin. -IGN

notes.title: Falnarion Tactics v0.8 update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33849709/47ac0b30da7fc3562205ba77f4df2a24a4e3cc1f.png[/img]
Hello everyone. Welcome to yet another update of Falnarion Tactics. I would like to let you know that there have been multiple fixes and updates between v0.7.5 and v0.7.6. Your clients probably got updated a lot and it was to fix bugs and issues as soon as I saw them. Unfortunately due to program limitations, some changes won't take place unless you make a new
game. While that doesn't sound great, it's not game breaking and you can always see the changes again if you decide to play on a new game or a new game+ when the game is finished.

Now without any more hesitation let us go over what is new:

-Added in Chapter 8.

-Added in Chapter 9.

-Added in a side quest; Lost Kingdom. -Solenars Edge Rebirth Quest.

-Added in a side quest; The Machinist. *You can unlock right away.*

-Added in a side quest; Stronghold 3.

-Added in a side quest; Double Trouble.

-New enemy; Harpy, found in Lost Kingdom.

-You can now set up camp (Have a base) in Lanoroque River before
the next chapter.

-Lowered durability on most weapons for more of a challenge
and a more frequent reason to hit the shops.

-Various fixes and changes.

-REMINDER- ESC no longer exits the game.

-Some icon changes for the skills.

-Fixed the bridge showing nothing when in a fight
in "The Machinist".

-Fixed Kefaro so he can now transform.

-Removed the ability for the Sword Master change for
Siegfried as it was meant for Arestol originally.

-Removed the class change ability for Felm as some unfixable
sprite changes arose. If you already changed classes in your save file
then you are safe. If not, then you won't be able to change classes anymore.
Felm will learn the skills he would have gotten in the class change from level 10 on wards. Also you can now buy a one time item. The "Felm Booster" is available for 4000 gold in the item shop and boosts stats of Felm slightly and gives one level up. This is to replicate the ability to class change as much as possible, but again it can only be used on Felm.

-Took the ability to transform from Ashelo. She shouldn't have had it in the first place.

-Removed the ability for Luna to become a Crow Tamer completely due to unfixable sprite issues.  *When he/she throws a weapon, the sprite disapears completely. So in short Luna will be able to transform into a Mercenary again and will no longer be able to transform into a Crow Tamer. *Also Luna was unable to change classes in the first place. Haha...* Derp.

-Added in Mercenaries in chapter 6.

*As of the v0.8 update all planned side quests are finished. Bringing the total to 27. There could be more before or after the game's release however it is unlikely as the main focus will finishing the main story.*

*Also only 3 more chapters till the game is finished.*

*IMPORTANT NOTICE* -Keep in mind that you can view the INFO command at any base for limited time only conversations. Some conversations change pertaining to having certain conditions met. For example if you have Whisper in your party and talk to Yamia. More chat options will open up to you. That is all for now. Please make sure to go back to this announcement to see any updated changes added during the update. 

Happy Holidays.

notes.title: There won't be a new Team Syukino game in 2020.
notes.content:
I decided I won't be making games in 2020. Once I finish my current projects, it's over. People don't want to pay for other people's hard work. I wonder why I am still making the games I do? I don't owe anyone anything. People want this and that for free and they don't care whose life it costs in the process it's really sad. You wouldn't want to go to a 9-5 job every week for free would you? You'd like to be paid doing something you don't really enjoy. I hope you can see my point; buy Indie games. But, people won't buy the games. It's okay because in the end it's the consumer's choice. But if you were able to see the money I made on steam, I guarantee you, you'd quit too. 2 years of being a dev and the total of all the game's sales combined couldn't even buy you a car. Anyways, I'll need to move on to new and better things. I'll be finishing Falnarion Tactics and hopefully my project after that in 2019. But then it's done. This is a solid, concrete choice that I am sure anyone in my position would make.

Thank you and happy holidays.

notes.title: Don't ignore the quests!
notes.content: Quests in this game are the same as Paralogues in Fire Emblem. They offer an extra side chapter that gives you gold, exp, bonus points, special fights, character bio unlocks and the chance to obtain some special units to join your army. If you are stuck on the main story, then simply do the quests. Keep in mind that some quests go away after a certain point in the story and some get unlocked later. It's highly suggested that you do all the quests as they come out as you can become very powerful. It extends the game-play and gives you an overall most satisfying flavor.

notes.title: Autumn Sale Begins Today!
notes.content:
Enjoy most of Team Syukino's products on sale for very cheap starting today till November 27th! Also to explain some recent developments on Falnarion Tactics:
The demo, was a flawed idea and it would have killed my sales in the long run. So to make it better for both the consumer and the developer. I thought it best to make the game early access so I don't turn into a one man skeleton crew for no pay. That way it's fair and I am always devout on my promises to update my games. So with that in mind, the 10 updates needed for the game to release will quickly turn into just 8 and the game will be out before you even know it. I am a person who HATES early access and the stigma behind it is sometimes well-deserved. But, I felt this time around and the only time I felt right in doing this was to do it for this game. I would not do this if it was an RPG maker game. It just felt right doing it this time around. I hope you understand. Also for those who got to download the demo, it should no longer work for you. If you got to play the game, consider yourselves lucky. But in time the content in the now obsolete demo will be quickly overshadowed by the amount of content soon to be available over time in the Early Access. Thank you and have a nice holiday!

https://steamcommunity.com/games/974180
^ If you'd like to join the steam group for FT.
